summary: Admitted thirteen adjudicated corrections from continuation 4 of the Jujutsu research, merged from nineteen candidates across six review arms, together with two product-choice decision cards. Four candidates in the diff and merge editor cluster are deferred rather than declined, one candidate is rejected as inside a continuation-3 rejection, and one is covered by existing canon. Canonical edits and independent review remained pending at this point.

Recorded Jared's answers to the seven shape questions the Part 1 adjudication raised, verbatim "I agree with all 7 of your recommendations. You can do all the next steps.", and to the two decision cards, verbatim "Do you recommendations for the choices." Compiled as DL-058, DL-056 and DL-057 in both Decision Log sections.

Compiled the thirteen corrections into JJI-003, JJI-006, JJI-008, SCS-005, SCS-014, SCS-015 and SCS-017 with their existing schemas and fixtures, across eight commits. Every cited passage was re-read on current main before editing and the drifted line numbers were re-verified; F106 to F109 and DL-051 to DL-054 covered none of the thirteen.

Extended the contract semantic gate with the jujutsu_integration_contracts branch carrying exactly four relational rules, each with one authored negative fixture that passes JSON Schema and fails only its own rule, under the authorization recorded as q-005. Added tests/test_pm_jujutsu_closure_semantics.py and updated the scoping assertion in tests/test_pm_source_control_effects.py. No other file under scripts/ changed.

Static verification recorded for the wave: contracts pass with 1047 positives and 3420 negatives against a 1041 and 3379 baseline, the configured shard check passes, plan index validation passes, and both semantic-gate test modules pass. Three questions remain open and none blocks landing.

Applied the four cheap notes from the independent review of this branch, which carried no blocking and no should-fix finding. N1 makes a dependency step mandatory in the closure materialization order with a "contains" constraint and a negative fixture, closing an order that named no dependency step at all. N2 names q-008, q-009 and q-010 in the five canon passages that mark the unenforced obligations, so a reader follows them by id rather than by description. N3 quotes DL-058's answer whole, including the third sentence about experiment tooling that the earlier prefix dropped. N6 adds the Part 1 record's machine twin to the evidence receipts with its hash. The review's two other notes, N4 on the gate branch reading the owner schema and N5 on the pre-existing absence of minItems on frozen prefixItems lists, were recorded observations and need no change.

Repaired this compile against the deterministic compile witness (scripts/pm-ledger-compile-witness.py, landed at 4f5eda0d18) and two blind form-driven reviews of the same draft. Three defect classes were repaired. First, five findings records named a unit as repaired that the compile queue never targeted: SCS-014 in records 4 and 5, 8 and 13, JJI-004 in record 9, and SCS-015 in record 10. Each of those units now carries the obligation its record says it was repaired for - the resolved isolation boundary, the store-entry reach of sanitization, the closure decision procedure, the colocated Git writer path under the GC fence, and the split qualification - and is a real target of the record's atoms in the compile queue. Second, twenty-two of fifty-six exact atom tokens reached only the schema and fixture companions and no owner prose, and fifty-three reached no owner registry; every one of the fifty-six now appears in an owner unit's prose and in an owner unit's preserved_exact_tokens. No token was forced into prose as a schema-only detail: each is a promise the unit already made in other words, and naming it makes the promise checkable. Third, the ten preserved_exact_tokens entries that occurred nowhere in their own unit's text, all of which predate this compile, are gone: each unit's prose now uses the exact registered words. Four prose defects the blind reviewers found and mechanical checks confirmed were repaired with them: the "where required" qualifier on ignore-working-copy in JJI-008, which the shipped schema pins to const true; the shared version block named in canon only by its property name; DL-056's safe next action inspect, absent from SCS-015; and gc_fence_covered_paths, never named in SCS-014. No schema or fixture semantics changed; every token named here already exists in the shipped schemas and fixtures. Two obligations that would need a schema change are recorded as open questions q-011 and q-012 rather than asserted, and neither blocks landing. All three witnesses now pass on this ledger.

Dispositioned the fifty-two findings three blind form-driven reviewers raised on this compile, which collapse to twenty-two distinct issues. Each claim was checked against the text, the shipped schemas and the shipped validator rather than against the reviewer's own quoted evidence. Beyond the witness repairs in evt-007, the confirmed record and reference defects repaired here are: DL-057 priced three new required fields on the confirmation record where the schema went from six to eight, so two; DL-058 cited five questions while answering seven shapes, and cited its third evidence path without the SHA-256 the other two carry; DL-056 called its four deferred candidates the only continuation-4 non-corrections where the authorization shard counts five; JJI-003 and JJI-006 stated the recovery-action admitted set more narrowly than JJI-008 and more narrowly than the shipped gate, which reads the command enum together with the declared owner routes; JJI-008 attributed q-009 to itself when it belongs to JJI-003, and read as landing a fourth store-entry obligation beyond the three this ledger authorizes; SCS-014 demoted to partial only where coverage could not be asserted, which the shipped schema already rejects for any path reported uncovered; and the findings shard's record 11 did not name JJI-003, where most of the recovery floor lives. Three reviewer claims were checked and rejected. Two asserted that native_toolchain_identity and graph_states occur in no unit in scope, when DL-058 carries both. One asked that the words or a declared owner route be dropped from JJI-008, which would make canon contradict the gate that admits them; the two narrower statements were widened instead. One reviewer's arithmetic on nineteen candidates reducing to thirteen records does not fail under the findings shard's own subtraction, and the real defect it gestured at, that the two source shards count different populations without saying so, is repaired in the findings shard instead. One further reviewer claim, that the pseudo-remote presentation clause is unauthorized, is rejected: the decision card DL-057 cites by hash contains it. What that reviewer saw correctly is that this ledger's own summary of the answer omits it, which is recorded as open question q-013. The remaining findings, their dispositions and the reasons are in reports/compile-repair-20260917/.

Recorded and applied Jared's answers of 2026-09-18 to the three questions this repair raised, verbatim "agree" to each recommendation as stated, relayed by the reviewer and recorded in /mnt/Cursor/PM-Experiments/research-audit-native-20260907/process-pilot-20260908/ANSWERS_20260918.md, SHA-256 ec15e8b383322546eed7eb699550b9444b5a27a9d1ab3e8b504adef095a0639c as read on 2026-09-18; agent-relayed and not verifiable from inside this repository. q-011 closes with no change: JJI-006 keeps projecting the recovery-action floor JJI-003 sets, and the effective-capability snapshot gets no field of its own. q-012 is applied as a rename of the property to native_toolchain_identity across both schemas, both fixture files and the prose, so the shared definition and the property it is carried under now have one name; the shared definition's name and its schema id were already that name and are unchanged. q-013 is applied to this ledger's own records: q-007's recorded answer and the bookmark-disclosure atom's negative constraints now carry the pseudo-remote clause the approved decision card contains and canon already stated. The compile witness exits 0 on this ledger after all three, and the contracts gate passes with every positive valid and every negative rejected. The governance reseal for the edited documents is owed to the designated Plans agent and is not performed here.
